question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place where fruit trees are grown
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Orchard"** refers to **a piece of land on which fruit trees are grown**. (फल बाग)

 
 
• **Example: **The apple **orchard** was in full bloom during the spring season.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Garden** (बगीचा): A plot of ground where flowers, shrubs, vegetables, fruits, or herbs are cultivated.

 
 
• **Example:** She loves spending time in her garden, growing various flowers and herbs.
 
 
 
• **Quay** (घाट): A structure built parallel to the bank of a waterway for use as a landing place.
 
 
• **Example:** The ship docked at the quay to unload its cargo.
 
 
 
• **Museum** (संग्रहालय): A building where objects of historical, scientific, artistic, or cultural interest are stored and exhibited.
 
 
• **Example:** We visited the museum to see the ancient artifacts.
